prompt: Objective: decide whether a bottling company should build a third bottling line. What you've learned: Line A runs at 97% utilization. Latest finding: Line B runs at 58%. What is the best next step?

options.text: Check whether Line B can take on Line A's work
options.feedback: Right. Spare capacity on Line B may remove the need to build, so test that first.

options.text: Test demand forecasts to size the third line
options.feedback: That assumes a third line is needed. Line B has spare capacity.

options.text: Plan where a third line could be built
Check that Line A's utilization is measured correctly

explanation: Line A is at 97% but Line B is at 58%. Test whether B can take over some of A's work before building.
